description: This file defines a utility enum `OpenClawKitResources` responsible for locating and providing access to a resource bundle named 'OpenClawKit_OpenClawKit'. It contains logic to find the bundle within various potential locations, supporting both packaged app and SwiftPM development/test environments.

classes.name: BundleLocator
classes.description: A helper class used solely for retrieving the bundle via `Bundle(for:)` to locate the resource bundle in certain environments.

methods.name: locateBundle
methods.description: Static method that attempts to locate the resource bundle by checking multiple locations in order: inside Bundle.main, via Bundle.module, or fallback to Bundle.main.

methods.name: loadModuleBundleSafely
methods.description: Static method that heuristically searches for the module bundle by examining common directory structures and potential resource locations, avoiding runtime crashes if the bundle is not found.
